# SparkClean

> SparkClean is a native macOS disk cleaner and storage analyzer for developer machines. It finds reviewable Xcode, Docker, node_modules, cache, duplicate-file, application-leftover, and disk-usage results without uploading scan data.

SparkClean requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later and supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Cleanup results are labeled Safe, Review, or Caution. Approved files move to Trash by default, protected locations are excluded, and the most recent Trash-backed cleanup can be restored before Trash is emptied. Command-based operations such as Docker pruning are identified separately.

The complete source is available to inspect and modify. SparkClean is free for personal, educational, academic, and other non-commercial use under its non-commercial license. It is source-available rather than OSI-approved open source. The project is created and maintained by George Khananaev.
